treatments.caseTitle: Clinical Diagnosis & Recovery Protocol for Acute Bovine Mastitis in Holstein Friesian
treatments.symptoms: High pyrexia (104.5 F), anorexia, swollen hard left quarter of udder with pain on palpation, blood-tinged watery milk secretion with clots.
treatments.diagnosis: Acute Clinical Mastitis caused by Coliform infection (E. coli). Confirmed via California Mastitis Test (CMT positive +++).
treatments.medication: Intramammary Infusion (Cefquinome Sulfate 75mg q12h x 3 days) + Systemic Ceftiofur Sodium 2.2 mg/kg IM q24h x 5 days + Flunixin Meglumine 2.2 mg/kg IV for endotoxemia and anti-inflammatory relief + Oxytocin 20 IU for complete quarter stripping.

treatments.caseTitle: Successful Therapeutic Management of Canine Parvoviral Enteritis in German Shepherd Puppy
treatments.symptoms: Severe hemorrhagic diarrhea with foul odor, persistent projectile vomiting, profound lethargy, subnormal temperature, and 9% dehydration.
treatments.diagnosis: Canine Parvovirus (CPV-2) enteritis. Confirmed positive via rapid fecal CPV antigen chromatographic test strip.
treatments.medication: Aggressive fluid therapy (Lactated Ringer's Solution + 5% Dextrose with 20 mEq/L KCl) + Maropitant (Cerenia) 1 mg/kg SC q24h + Ampicillin/Sulbactam 30 mg/kg IV q8h to prevent bacterial translocation + Metoclopramide CRI + Metronidazole IV.
